## Summary

What changed and why?

## Type

- [ ] Feature
- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Test/QA
- [ ] Refactor/chore

## Verification

- [ ] Backend tests pass (if backend changed)
- [ ] `ruff check app tests` passes (if backend changed)
- [ ] `npm run lint` passes (if frontend changed)
- [ ] `npm run build` passes (if frontend changed)
- [ ] Relevant browser flow tested
- [ ] Responsive/accessibility impact checked for UI changes

## Security / data

- [ ] No secrets or `.env` files committed
- [ ] Authorization/ownership rules preserved
- [ ] No private customer images/data added
- [ ] Third-party asset/model licenses reviewed if applicable

## Screenshots

Add before/after screenshots for meaningful UI changes.

## Notes / limitations

List migrations, env changes, known limitations or follow-up work.
